theme: An open Saturday, one reset waiting tomorrow.
greeting: The day is yours, Dan — nothing on the calendar until tomorrow's Sunday reset with Mike. A good window to clear the two things that keep sliding.

needsAttention.detail: Your weekly 15-minute board reset is at 9 AM tomorrow. A pass through the shared board tonight — owners and dates on the overdue items — is the agenda you'll open with.
